name: tidy
engine: SQLite 3.37 or newer, STRICT tables (the Docker image has 3.46)
file: /data/tidy.db inside the container, on the tidy-data volume. Created automatically when missing.

pragmas.foreign_keys: ON, set on every connection (SQLite defaults to OFF)

conventions.ids: TEXT UUID v4 for entities; INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT for messages and ai_messages (they need a total order)
conventions.timestamps: TEXT, UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds and a Z suffix, e.g. 2026-11-15T08:30:00.000Z. Sortable as text.
conventions.dates: due_date is a plain Gregorian yyyy-MM-dd calendar day, not an instant
conventions.bilingual_text: column x holds the text as written; column x_fa is set only for sample data. See DATABASE.md section 2.
conventions.nullable: every column has an explicit "nullable": true or false; false means NOT NULL
conventions.positions: display order columns start at 1; cards.position is a gapped integer

tables.name: users
tables.purpose: Everyone on a team. Only users with a password_hash can sign in. Also holds the per-user settings.

columns.name: id
columns.note: UUID v4 text, generated by the client or the server

columns.name: password_hash
columns.note: scrypt 'salt_hex:hash_hex'; NULL = this user cannot sign in

columns.name: name
columns.note: display name as written (English for sample users)

columns.name: name_fa
columns.note: Persian display name, sample users only

tables.name: sessions
tables.purpose: Signed-in browsers. The cookie holds a random token; only its SHA-256 is stored here.

columns.name: token_hash
columns.note: SHA-256 hex of the cookie token

tables.name: boards
tables.purpose: A Kanban board. Everything a team sees hangs off a board.

columns.name: id
columns.note: UUID v4 text, generated by the client or the server

tables.name: board_members
tables.purpose: Who is on a board's team, in display order. The owner is the user who signs in; teammates may be users who cannot sign in.

indexes.name: idx_board_members_user
indexes.note: find a user's board at sign-in

indexes.name: uq_user_one_owned_board
indexes.note: MVP rule: one board per user. Dropping this index lifts it.

tables.name: columns
tables.purpose: The fixed board columns (ideas, todo, doing, review, done). Only the name, WIP limit and collapsed state change.

columns.name: id
columns.note: UUID v4 text, generated by the client or the server

columns.name: slug
columns.note: stable identity: ideas, todo, doing, review, done. The API exposes it as the column id.

columns.name: name
columns.note: set only when the user renames the column; NULL = show the translated default

tables.name: labels
tables.purpose: A board's labels (design, frontend, bug, docs, testing). The label colour comes from the slug in the UI.

columns.name: id
columns.note: UUID v4 text, generated by the client or the server

columns.name: slug
columns.note: stable identity used for the colour

columns.name: name
columns.note: label name as written (English for sample labels)

tables.name: cards
tables.purpose: Kanban cards. Deleting a card sets deleted_at (so Undo restores it exactly); a purge removes it for good later.

columns.name: id
columns.note: UUID v4 text, generated by the client or the server

columns.name: board_id
columns.note: repeated from the column so access checks need no join

columns.name: position
columns.note: order inside the column, gapped integers (steps of 1024); see DATABASE.md section 3

columns.name: seq
columns.note: creation order within the board; orders the rooms list

columns.name: due_date
columns.check: due_date IS NULL OR date(due_date) IS due_date
columns.note: Gregorian yyyy-MM-dd, a calendar day (not an instant); shown in the Jalali calendar

tables.name: card_labels
tables.purpose: Labels on a card, in the order they were added.

tables.name: card_members
tables.purpose: Users assigned to a card, in the order they were added (the avatar stack order).

tables.name: spaces
tables.purpose: Chat spaces: one General channel per board and one room per card.

columns.name: id
columns.note: UUID v4 text, generated by the client or the server

columns.name: card_id
columns.note: the card this room belongs to; NULL for General. The API exposes the space id as 'general' or the card id.

tables.name: messages
tables.purpose: Everything in a conversation: chat messages, system events (progress, members, moves) and 'task created' announcements.

columns.name: id
columns.note: monotonic and never reused: gives the order and powers the unread model

columns.name: author_id
columns.note: the user who wrote it or caused the event

columns.name: text
columns.note: kind = message only; as written (English for sample messages)

columns.name: event
columns.check: event IS NULL OR event IN ('progress','added','removed','moved','created','updated')

columns.name: event_value
columns.check: event_value IS NULL OR event_value BETWEEN 0 AND 100

columns.name: card_id
columns.note: kind = task: the card that was created from a message

columns.name: by_ai
columns.note: 1 = done by the AI assistant (events only)

checks: (event IS NOT NULL AND event IN ('added','removed')) = (event_member_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_messages_space
indexes.note: a conversation in order; unread counts

tables.name: images
tables.purpose: Chat images stored as BLOBs. A row belongs to at most one message. Sample images have no bytes and show as placeholders.

columns.name: id
columns.note: UUID v4 text, generated by the client or the server

columns.name: board_id
columns.note: access: only members of this board may read it

columns.name: message_id
columns.note: NULL until the message is sent

columns.name: file_name
columns.note: original file name, shown as the alt text

columns.name: mime_type
columns.check: mime_type IS NULL OR mime_type IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')

indexes.name: idx_images_unattached
indexes.note: purging uploads that never got a message

tables.name: space_reads
tables.purpose: Unread model: how far each user has read each space. No row = nothing read yet.

columns.name: last_read_message_id
columns.note: a plain number, not a foreign key, so deleting a message never touches read state

indexes.name: idx_space_reads_space
indexes.note: cascade when a room is removed

tables.name: ai_messages
tables.purpose: The AI assistant conversation, one continuous thread per user and board.

columns.name: changes
columns.note: JSON object {"applied": [changes the assistant made], "problem": null or why nothing was changed} for this reply
